entries.note: Honigberg 2010 PNAS (PMID 20615965) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract. Opening untested entry at 2010 fine; FDA PharmR confirms dog 100 mg/kg complete occupancy 24 h.

Advani JCO (PMID 23045577) epub 2012-10-08; quote verbatim. Same probe, direct readout, full occupancy in patients. registry_date 2009-02-24 is first-posting; NCT00849654 has no results, so field should be null.
Quote verbatim in Honigberg abstract; occupancy-tied-to-efficacy is a model-stated target, borderline but the phase 1 escalated against it. Untested opening fine.

Advani quote verbatim (design sentence; the occupancy-reached sentence would be the stronger quote). Target reached -> same; margin_stated false correct (dog tolerability unpublished pre-trial). registry_date should be null as above.
Quote verbatim in Honigberg abstract. Canine B-NHL is cross-histology (DLBCL-like) model; opening untested fine.

Wang NEJM (PMID 23782157) epub 2013-06-19, ORR primary endpoint, quote verbatim; NCT01236391 results first posted 2015-03-13 confirmed. ACE-LY-004 quote verbatim; Harrington dog ORR 25% (5/20) confirmed.
Zhang CCR 2017 (PMID 28348046) quote verbatim but generic: abstract does not show MCL-specific ibrutinib donor/PDX pairs. Retro, patient-level reasonable; keep low confidence.
Quote verbatim in bundled PharmR text (Reference ID 3360071). Opening proxy at 2009 first-in-human acceptable.
Quote verbatim; review states platelets rose in rats/dogs. AF is not in the review text; it is in the 2013 MCL label, so the AF miss is drafter pairing. Contra holds on thrombocytopenia alone.
Zhang 2025 Sci Adv (PMC12680032) full text read; quote verbatim from abstract. Opening untested entry at 2025, first MCL use; patient-level fine.

Full text: 4 AVO patients (1 R/R, 3 untreated) classed by circulating-lymphocyte kinetics after cycle-1 acalabrutinib, then assayed; retro correct, not same. Readout is not the trial endpoint and mostly outside R/R; low confidence apt.
Rahal 2014 Nat Med (PMID 24362935, epub 2013-12-22); quote verbatim in abstract. Opening untested 2013, patient-level prediction of ibrutinib insensitivity.

entries.rule: same/contra from a pairing whose trial source attributes the result to conditions the model never tested -> untested (untested_reason unsettled)
entries.note: Freeman 2022 abstract: BIRC3 harm shown 'in this cohort', pooled over ibrutinib and temsirolimus arms; no ibrutinib-arm result, so prognostic, not ibrutinib insensitivity. Propose untested/unsettled unless full text shows arm-specific effect.
entries.adjudication_note: Checker's rule (trial attributes result to conditions model never tested) and rule 5: Freeman reports BIRC3 harm pooled over ibrutinib and temsirolimus arms (abstract; full text paywalled), so ibrutinib-specific insensitivity is unsettled.

entries.note: Quote verbatim in bundled 213217 MultidisciplineR (line ~1103). Opening untested at first-in-human proxy 2014; model_filed true supported.

Telemetry quote verbatim; review shows multi-organ hemorrhage in animals, dog platelets rising, patient AF/flutter 2% and thrombocytopenia. Contra consistent with ibrutinib track judgement. registry_date 2022 postdates year; year 2019 fine.

Bundled 210259 MultidisciplineR (Ref ID 4173186): quote verbatim in the toxicology overview. Rat 26-week, dog 91-day/39-week and dog telemetry filed; untested opening at the 2014 first-in-human proxy year is fine.

Quote verbatim. Review confirms dog 39-week red-cell decreases only, rat heart hemorrhage only in moribund 300/200 mg/kg females; ACE-LY-004 hemorrhage 31.5% (major 0.8%), platelets decreased 44.4%, AF 0. Contra judgement consistent with sibling tracks.

missing: Ex-vivo primary MCL/CLL cell buoyant-mass change vs in-vivo BTK inhibitor sensitivity, patient-level, comparison stated (Science Advances 2025, doi:10.1126/sciadv.ady2963, PMID 41348872): 'changes in cell buoyant mass within primary patient specimens ex vivo correlate with sensitivity to Bruton's tyrosine kinase inhibitors in vivo in MCL'. New track (ex_vivo, patient-level).

MCL cell-line pharmacogenomic profiling (Rahal 2014 Nat Med, doi:10.1038/nm.3435, PMID 24362935): ibrutinib-insensitive lines carry alternative NF-kB (TRAF2/BIRC3) lesions, found in 15% of 165 patients; a patient-level prediction of primary ibrutinib resistance. Track at least as untested/unsettled, or scored if a later patient-outcome paper tests TRAF2/BIRC3 vs response.

Acalabrutinib and zanubrutinib (members) have their own FDA nonclinical reviews (NDA 210259, 2017; NDA 213217, 2019) not in the bundle: dog/rat tox vs patient AF, bleeding and cytopenias should be checked as further safety entries on a tox track.

Acalabrutinib canine B-NHL (Harrington 2016, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0159607) and zanubrutinib occupancy (PBMC and lymph-node, Tam 2019 Blood) are in notes only; they would be member-drug entries on the existing canine and occupancy tracks, no status change.

Acalabrutinib rat/dog GLP toxicology and dog telemetry (NDA 210259 MultidisciplineR 2017, in bundle): 'acalabrutinib had no toxicologically-significant effects on cardiovascular function in a cardiovascular study in telemetered dogs', while label lists AF/flutter 3% and hemorrhage; would be a safety track parallel to the ibrutinib/zanubrutinib tox tracks (likely contra).

Acalabrutinib platelet-function models (light-transmission aggregometry and humanized VWF-HA1 mouse thrombus formation) predicted fewer platelet effects than ibrutinib (FDA NDA 210259 MultidisciplineR 2017, pharmacology section); compare ELEVATE-RR head-to-head bleeding/AF (Byrd 2021 JCO, doi:10.1200/JCO.21.01210, CLL, imported_from). A comparative-safety track not drafted.
rule_questions: registry_date when the trial registry has no results posted: the draft uses the first-posting date; rule 6 reads as results posting only, implying null. Which?

Safety year when the FDA review was signed 2013 (MCL approval Nov 2013, NDA 205552 Orig1) but the bundled copy sits in the 2014 Orig2 folder: does the year follow the earliest public posting of any copy of the review (possibly 2013 under Orig1)?
Is 'occupancy correlated with efficacy' in a mouse paper a model-stated dose target for the dose cell, or only an engagement prediction, given the brief bars targets the model never stated?
magnitude 'opposite' on a silence-contradicted harm where animals moved the lab value the other way (platelets rose): the brief defines 'opposite' for a predicted harm that never appeared.

Is a biomarker's pooled prognostic effect across a randomized trial's in-class and out-of-class arms (RAY: ibrutinib vs temsirolimus) admissible as a same for a model predicting in-class insensitivity, or untested?
